text_en: Now when it was reported to Sanballat and Tobiah and to Geshem the Arab and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall and that there was no gap left in it (though up to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),
text_cn: 当桑巴拉特、托彼雅、阿剌伯人革笙和我们其他的仇敌，一听说我重修了城墙，已没有破口的地方，——虽然到那时，我还没有在门上安装门扇，——

text_en: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come and let us meet together in one of the villages in the plain of Ono. ” But they intended to do me harm.
text_cn: 桑巴拉特和革笙，便派人到我这里说：“请来，我们在敖诺平原的一个村镇中会晤。” 其实他们是企图谋害我。

text_en: So I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work and I cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to come down to you? ”
text_cn: 我遂派使者去答复他们说：“我作的工程浩大，不能前去。我怎能离开工作，到你们那里去，而使工程停顿呢？”

text_en: They sent to me four times in this way, and I answered them in the same manner.
text_cn: 他们如此连续四次，遣使者到我这里，我也同样答复了他们。

text_en: In the same way Sanballat for the fifth time sent his servant to me with an open letter in his hand.
text_cn: 随后，桑巴拉特第五次，又同样打发他的臣仆来，手中拿着一封未封的信，

text_en: In it was written, “It is reported among the nations—and Geshem also says it—that you and the Jews intend to rebel; that is why you are building the wall; and according to this report you wish to become their king.
text_cn: 信上写着说：“在各民族中传说，而且革笙也证实此说：你和犹太人图谋造反，为此你才重修城墙；据说你还要为王。

text_en: You have also set up prophets to proclaim in Jerusalem concerning you, ‘There is a king in Judah! ’ And now it will be reported to the king according to these words. So come, therefore, and let us confer together. ”
text_cn: 并且你派定了先知，在耶路撒冷为你宣传说：犹大有了王！现今这些话势必传到君王那里，所以请你来，我们互相商议商议。”

text_en: Then I sent to him, saying, “No such things as you say have been done; you are inventing them out of your own mind”
text_cn: 我遂遣使者向他说：“决没有像你所说的那些事，是你心中虚构的。”

text_en: —for they all wanted to frighten us, thinking, “Their hands will drop from the work, and it will not be done. ” But now, O God, strengthen my hands.
text_cn: 其实，他们是企图恐吓我们，心想：“如此他们必放弃那工程，不再工作下去。”但我的力量更坚强了。

text_en: One day when I went into the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah son of Mehetabel, who was confined to his house, he said, “Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us close the doors of the temple, for they are coming to kill you; indeed, tonight they are coming to kill you. ”
text_cn: 有一天，我来到默塔贝耳的孙子，德拉雅的儿子舍玛雅的家里，他正闭门在家，对我说：“我们上天主的殿，到圣所里去会晤，关好圣所的门户，因为他们要来杀你，且今夜要来杀你。”

text_en: But I said, “Should a man like me run away? Would a man like me go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in! ”
text_cn: 我答说：“像我这样的人，能逃避到圣所中，保全生命吗？我决不进去！”

text_en: Then I perceived and saw that God had not sent him at all, but he had pronounced the prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
text_cn: 我觉察出来，不是天主打发他向我讲这预言，而是托彼雅和桑巴拉特贿赂了他，

text_en: He was hired for this purpose, to intimidate me and make me sin by acting in this way, and so they could give me a bad name, in order to taunt me.
text_cn: 要他恐吓我，使我那样去作犯罪的事，如此给他们留下一种坏名誉，好藉以辱骂我。

text_en: Remember Tobiah and Sanballat, O my God, according to these things that they did, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets who wanted to make me afraid.
text_cn: 我的天主！请你按照托彼雅和桑巴拉特之所行，记忆他们！也不要忘却诺阿狄雅女先知和其余的先知，因为他们企图使我恐惧。

text_en: So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.
text_cn: “厄路耳”月二十五日，城垣完成，共计为时五十二日。

text_en: And when all our enemies heard of it, all the nations around us were afraid and fell greatly in their own esteem; for they perceived that this work had been accomplished with the help of our God.
text_cn: 我们所有的仇敌一听说这事，我们四周的人民一看见这事，都十分惊异，并承认这工程，是赖我们的天主而完成的。

text_en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.
text_cn: 在此期间，犹大有些有权势的人，给托彼雅寄了许多函件，托彼雅也有复函寄回。

text_en: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah: and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
text_cn: 因为犹大有许多人，与他宣誓为盟，因他原是阿辣黑的儿子，舍加尼雅的女婿，他的儿子约哈南，又娶了贝勒革雅的儿子默叔蓝的女儿为妻。

text_en: Also they spoke of his good deeds in my presence, and reported my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.
text_cn: 他们常在我面前称道他的善行，也将我的事向他报告，托彼雅遂来信恐吓我。
